text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, we open the textbook and 
begin training!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And a deserted island...?
choice_data_list:
I want to run on different "sand" than 
what's at the academy.

I want to run on a different kind of 
"sand" than what we have at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if we broadly say 'dirt', there's a 
wide variance in the quality of the sand."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Central dirt, regional dirt. On top of 
that, regional tracks have different sand 
depths depending on the venue, so each 
racecourse has its own distinct 
characteristics.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then rather than specializing in one type 
of sand... I need the versatility to adapt 
to any track."
choice_data_list:
Because the sand quality here is right in 
the middle.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Quit trying to sound so smart! All I 
gotta do is run, right?!
choice_data_list:
We'll even clock your speed with a speed 
gun!

We'll even clock your speed with a speed 
gun!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ryaaaaaaah~~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meticulously record the speed of the 
accelerating Espoir City in my notebook.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who set the pace from the front, 
such as Front Runners and Leaders, require 
precise internal clocks to gauge the 
race's overall tempo. And—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO~~~ Traiiineeeer! I gotta be 
clocking 60 km/h right nooow~~!
choice_data_list: No, right now it's 50 km/h!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That ain't nearly enough, is it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To act as a pacemaker, you must know how 
fast you're running. —Honing that instinct 
is just as crucial.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah... phew... Trainer... next is――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run at exactly 55 km/h. ...Don't 
underestimate my internal speedometer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City continued to stack up her 
training after that, growing steadily...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hellll yeah!! 1st place in the mock race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had improved to the point where she 
could produce results even when competing 
against the academy's top Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this result will guide me to the next 
step.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Trainer and Espo too! Having you 
two visit me together feels just like a 
home visit♪

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Please, come over here and take a seat. 
What brings you here today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—About four months ago, her mother quietly 
shared her heartfelt concerns for her 
daughter.
choice_data_list:
(That's exactly why... I want to tell them 
directly how much I've grown.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I totally smashed it and took 1st place in 
the mock race!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There were even Umamusume who run in 
graded races, but it was soooo totally 
easy!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Espo really is strong~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
――! OF COUUUUURSE!! Told ya it'd be a 
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes narrowed gently in front of her 
mother. However, today's report didn't end 
there.
choice_data_list:
She has the ability to run in Dirt GⅠ 
races.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat...?! Espo? In a dirt GⅠ?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This guy's spouting nonsense about 
"waiting and seeing until summer," though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well... she's pretty much guaranteed to 
run.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa~! A GⅠ... is every Umamusume's 
dream, you know? Mom wanted to run in one 
too, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The potential race for now is October's 
'Mile Championship Nambu Hai.' If the 
timing works out—
choice_data_list:
I'll take first place at the Mile CS Nambu 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, fair enough. Not really anything to be 
surprised about.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Such a magnificent goal...! Um, Trainer, 
do you really believe in this girl that 
much...?
choice_data_list:
She is strong enough to live up to those 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Right. Someone like me can take 1st 
place.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...I see...! Hehe, you're right...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Espo. Can Mama come over to your side? 
Just for a little bit... Sorry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen you in a little while and 
you've gotten even bigger... Seriously... 
Espo, you really are something...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right! I have to let Dad 
know too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...To my old man?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
They stepped out just before you arrived. 
I'll contact them to come right back.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, why did it have to be on a day 
like this...? And after I told them in 
advance that Espo was coming home, too...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: It's totally fine!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Like I care about my old man anyway.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ………… I don't wanna see 'em either.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Espo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Espoir City's fierce 
intensity, something suddenly crossed my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Idiot! As if that old bastard would ever 
have high hopes for me!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...That guy...! Even though he's a trainer 
at a development club...! He totally made 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that bravado, several paths 
have closed off to her. Including the 
whole matter with her father."
choice_data_list: (So you're Espoir City's father...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems it's still too early to end 
our "home visit."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, are you sure this is far enough? I 
can walk you to the station, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just come on! Get inside the house 
already! Let's go, Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Sorry, go on ahead without me. There's 
somewhere I need to stop by.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?
choice_data_list: Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah... HEY!! Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The pharmacy is right around that corner 
to the right! For the supermarket, take a 
left at the third intersection!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Warmed by her underlying thoughtfulness 
and kindness, I set off running toward our 
destination.
choice_data_list: The biggest training club around here is—

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Chief! You have a visitor! Sounds like 
it's your daughter's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: "Haaah? When you say your daughter's..."
choice_data_list: Hello, nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The man with sun-tanned skin had the same 
hair color as Espoir City... and his 
straight nose bore a striking resemblance 
to hers.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Here. It's a cramped office, but... here's 
some tea.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a bit hot. I'll bring some water 
right now."
choice_data_list: No, please don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...I got a message from my wife. You were 
at my place with Espo just a little while 
ago, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her father crossed his arms and fell 
silent for just a brief moment. Radiating 
a piercing, intimidating aura, he furrowed 
his brow—

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—...My wife must know it too, though. 
Things probably would've been better 
without me around.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
If I'm at home, she won't even be able to 
talk properly. ...We wouldn't even get to 
talk about the important stuff, would we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given Espoir City's hostility, I thought 
her father was "her enemy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet meeting her in person, she's rough 
around the edges, but... awkwardness seems 
to win out over anything else—
choice_data_list: Um, the reason you weren't home was...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Forget about that, let's get down to 
business. It's about my daughter and me 
anyway, isn't it?
choice_data_list: ...Will you tell me about it?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, Trainer, what did you say 
to that timid girl to get her to run?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"By putting on a brave face, she's trying 
to hide her true feelings... that girl."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There was probably no need to force 
myself to hide anything here. I explained 
everything that had happened with her, 
step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because she puts on a tough front and 
lacks confidence in herself, coaching her 
through training was quite a struggle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... ever since using that 
"textbook" to give her a temporary boost 
of confidence, her condition has been on 
the rise.
choice_data_list:
...This is strictly a temporary fix, 
however.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someday, she will have to... face her own 
weaknesses and overcome them herself.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You seem to be guiding them 
quite skillfully."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do it like that. I ended up 
choosing a much more direct approach.
choice_data_list: A direct approach, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
I told them straight out. To admit their 
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Because mental issues are something 
that ought to be resolved quickly.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
In fact, all the Umamusume I've instructed 
have overcome their weaknesses and grown 
significantly. And yet, she...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Even on that day, she was just doing 
reckless training that was way beyond her 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"‘Admit that what you can't do, you can't 
do!! You idiot...!!’"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... You're weak as hell, so stop 
pushing yourself so damn hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
If someone didn't stop you, your legs 
would've been ruined. If not now, then 
someday in the future. ...That's why.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak! 
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any 
stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Screw you... Screw you, screw you! Don't 
you dare call me weak!! You damn old 
man!!"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—It started back then. That's when she 
began rebelling like a raging fire.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...It was supposed to be a necessary 
education. I've seen plenty of girls just 
like her.

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, what kind of education do you 
think Espoir needs?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"For an Umamusume... for that girl. What 
do you think the role of an educator is?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...So slow. When is she gonna get back?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Did you get lost or something? If so, you 
could've at least given me a call—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Espo-saaann!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Nwah, Falco!? The hell are you doing so 
suddenly?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Teach Falco all about dirt racing!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Espo-san took 1st place in the mock dirt 
race the other day, right? That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please, please! It's Falco's favor of a 
lifetiiime☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold up, Falco! I know what's going on, 
you know!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You were on the turf! ...In the Classic 
Triple Crown! You ran in the Satsuki Sho, 
dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Something about wanting to be a top 
umadol! ...Isn't that why you chose turf!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but my challenge on turf is over! 
I've made up my mind, and I'm going full 
speed ahead on the dirt path!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You... just 'cause it didn't suit you? 
Just 'cause you gave up... you're coming 
to the dirt?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just because I'm weak, I'm giving up on my 
dream—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's the opposite! Falco isn't giving up 
on her dream! What I've always aimed to be 
is the 'Top Umadol on Dirt'!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I knew I couldn't win the Satsuki Sho. 
But you can only sing 'winning the soul' 
if you're on the Classic Triple Crown 
path."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I knew my true aptitude, I wanted 
to take on this first and last challenge.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm going to seriously study 
dirt racing! I'll work as hard as I can to 
make up for my late start!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's with the 'Right?'...

text_block_list.name: Falco & Espo
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, it's the favor of a 
lifetiiime! ...Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An awkward father, and his daughter's 
Trainer. A chick of the dirt, and a 
rebellious daughter eager to howl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps this encounter, too, will tie 
into our future."
